sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 2002
PRIVATE UNIVERSITIES AND EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTES LAWS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend certain laws relating to the
Private Universities and Educational Institutes in force in the Province of
Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 12th October, 2002]
No.S.Legis.l(37)/2002, dated
12-10-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Private Universities
and Educational Institutes Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

1. The Hamdard University Act,
1991.
After section 7, the following
shall be added:--
"7-A(1) (i) The Patron may
cause an inspection or inquiry to be made on his own motion in respect of any
matter connected with the affairs of, the University and shall, from time to
time, direct any person or persons to inquire into or carry out inspection
of.--
(ii) the University, its
building, laboratories, libraries, and other facilities;
(iii) any institution,
department or hostel maintained by the University;
(iv) the adequacy of financial
and human resources;
(v) the teaching, research,
curriculum, examination and other matters of the University; and
(vi) such other matters as may
be specified by him.
(2) The Patron shall
communicate to the Board his views with regard to the result of visitation
and shall, after ascertaining the views of the Board, advise the Board on the
action to be taken by it.
(3) The Board shall, within
such time as may be specified by the Patron, communicate to him such action,
if any, as has been taken or may be proposed to be taken upon the results of
visitation.
(4) Where the Board does not,
within the time specified, take the satisfaction of the Patron, the may issue
such directions as he deems and the Board shall comply with all such
directions.
(5) The Patron shall have full
powers to, take any action, as he may deem fit against the University,
including withdrawal of charter and its closure.
7-B. The University shall work
within the frame work of the Education Policy and guide lines framed by
Government from time to time.
7-C. Annual monitoring charges
as fixed by Government from time to time shall be paid by the University
through a pay order in the name of Secretary Education Government of Sindh,
for University funds being maintained by the Governor Secretariat."
